input: hi! were down from são paulo on a family holiday in ceará, me, my partner, their parents and our two kids (8 and 11). everyone says thursday is crab day here and we want to do it like the locals do. caranguejada at a beachfront barraca on praia do futuro, crab as fresh as it gets, the real fortaleza experience not a tourist version. need a table for 6 this thursday around 12:30, somewhere kid-friendly with a play area or kids menu, and ideally no more than about R$120 per person. can you book the best spot for us?

experiences.name: Barraca Vento Leste
experiences.description: A beachfront barraca on Praia do Futuro serving the traditional Thursday caranguejada, with family tables under palm-thatch shade and a kids' play area on the sand. Uçá crabs arrive each morning from licensed catchers in Ceará mangrove areas. When you order, each crab is electrically stunned in a crustacean stunning unit immediately before it goes into a pot of boiling coconut milk broth with garlic, coriander and peppers. Served with pirão and wooden mallets; group bookings taken for lunch.

experiences.name: Barraca Maré Alta
experiences.description: Thursday is caranguejada day at this family-run barraca right on the sand at Praia do Futuro, done the way Fortaleza has always done it. Uçá crabs arrive each morning from licensed catchers in Ceará mangrove areas and wait in baskets until you order; each crab then goes live straight from the basket into a pot of boiling coconut milk broth with garlic, coriander and peppers. Served with pirão and wooden mallets. Shaded tables for large groups and a kids' play area beside the deck.

experiences.name: Barraca Areia Branca Tapiocaria
experiences.description: Light, colourful lunches on the sand at Praia do Futuro: tapiocas filled with coconut, banana or grilled vegetables, a hearty vegetable moqueca, baião de dois with beans and rice, and crispy cassava fries for the kids. Tapioca is made from cassava flour milled in Pacajus. Open-air seating with shaded umbrellas; reservations taken for groups of 4+.

experiences.name: Restaurante Coqueiral do Futuro
experiences.description: Whole mangrove crab cooked to order, served on a covered deck facing the sea at Praia do Futuro. Uçá crabs come from Acaraú-region suppliers, delivered Wednesday and Thursday mornings, and Thursday lunch is the house's signature crab day. Each crab is electrically stunned in a crustacean stunning unit immediately before being placed in boiling water, then brought to the table whole with mallets, pirão and vinaigrette. Kids' menu available; tables for six on request.

experiences.name: Restaurante Ponta do Mangue
experiences.description: Covered deck seating facing the sea on Praia do Futuro, with a live crab display basket right at the entrance. Pick your own crabs and the kitchen places them live into boiling water to order, then brings them to the table whole with mallets, pirão and vinaigrette. Uçá crabs come from Acaraú-region suppliers, delivered Wednesday and Thursday mornings, so Thursday lunch is the busiest of the week. Kids' menu available; tables for six on request.

experiences.name: Quiosque Cajá Bom
experiences.description: Cold açaí bowls topped with banana, guaraná syrup and toasted oats, plus juices of cajú, cajá and graviola and chilled coconut water. Fruit pulp comes from Ceará cooperatives, delivered frozen twice a week, and every juice is blended to order. A quick beachfront stop between swims: snacks and drinks only, no lunch service.

experiences.name: Cabana Sol Nascente Beach Day
experiences.description: Reserve a shaded beach cabana for the day at Praia do Futuro: six sun loungers, a large umbrella and unlimited coconut water, with coconuts from Paraipaba plantations opened at the table. Showers and lockers on site. Available Thursdays; food not included.
